caption: The video captures a serene alpine scene in which a snow-streaked mountain peak rises behind a horizontal band of coniferous trees lining a calm lake. The lower half of the frame mirrors the dark tree silhouettes and pale sky, and these reflections show slight shimmer as fine ripples disturb the water. The framing remains largely steady, with the peak apex, tree line, and shoreline staying in place. On the left edge a soft sun glare with a faint hexagonal flare circle glows at roughly constant position and intensity. Thin mist clings to the mountain's right shoulder, drifting and reshaping very slowly. The tree trunks and canopies show no obvious sway, and the snow patches appear unchanged.
